summary: Verified icon-overlap fix on auth forms. Tested Login, Register, ForgotPassword at 1440x900 desktop and 360x760 mobile, in both regular and Senior Mode. All icons (Mail/Lock/User) have pointer-events:none confirmed via computed style. Inputs preserve left padding (51px regular, 60px senior) so icon sits in padding zone and never overlaps typed text. Clicking directly over the icon focuses the correct input both before and after typing, and typed value remains intact. Senior Mode CSS correctly overrides only padding-top/padding-bottom, leaving horizontal padding untouched. Submit buttons remain clickable. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Confort+/Senior toggle was not discoverable on the /login page via common selectors (no data-testid='senior-toggle' etc.). Senior mode was activated by manually adding the .senior-mode class to <html>. If the toggle lives only in the authenticated navbar, that's fine; otherwise consider exposing it on public auth pages so seniors can enable it before signing up. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: not used (fix is pure CSS/DOM, verified without login)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Icon overlap fix on auth pages is fully verified. If touching Senior Mode CSS again, remember: forcing horizontal padding globally on inputs will re-break icon-adjacent inputs. Test measurement approach: getBoundingClientRect on input + icon, then compare icon.right vs input.left + parseFloat(paddingLeft). ResetPassword/:token was not visited (requires a valid token) but its source uses the same pattern with pointer-events-none — safe by inspection. Account page with Mail icon likewise not visited (requires auth) but same pattern.
rca of the issue: RCA (as reported by main agent, confirmed): (a) html.senior-mode input { padding: 0.85rem 1rem !important } was overriding tailwind's pl-12 (48px) with 16px, so the absolutely-positioned Mail/Lock/User icon at left:16px sat on top of the typed value; (b) icons lacked pointer-events-none, so clicks over the icon area could be swallowed by the SVG rather than reaching the input. Fix: senior-mode now only overrides padding-top/padding-bottom (0.85rem each) preserving pl-12; all icons received pointer-events-none. Verified: pl computed = 51px/60px (regular/senior), pointer-events=none, icon_right < text_start on every measured input, click-through to input works.
